flow.name: support-tools-get-order-status-flow
flow.doc:name: Get Order Status Tool
flow.doc:description: MCP tool that looks up a TechWave order via the Order Support API behind the ingress GW

mcp:tool-listener.name: get-order-status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Tool: get-order-status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Exposes get-order-status as an MCP tool that returns a TechWave order's status, items and payment
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Retorna o status de um pedido TechWave, incluindo itens, cliente e situação do pagamento. Use sempre que o cliente perguntar sobre um pedido.

logger.doc:name: Flow start
logger.doc:description: Logs START tracePoint with the requested orderId
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Tool get-order-status invoked', tracePoint: 'START'} ++ ({ orderId: payload.orderId })]

set-variable.doc:name: Set orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the tool input orderId into a flow variable

logger.doc:name: Before Orders API call
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST as the flow calls the Order Support API
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Calling Order Support API for ' ++ vars.orderId, tracePoint: 'BEFORE_REQUEST'}]

http:request.doc:name: Call Order Support API
http:request.doc:description: GETs /orders/{orderId} from the Order Support API behind the ingress GW

logger.doc:name: After Orders API call
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST once the Order Support API has responded
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Order Support API responded for ' ++ vars.orderId, tracePoint: 'AFTER_REQUEST'}]

ee:transform.doc:name: To JSON string
ee:transform.doc:description: Serialises the order payload to a JSON string for the MCP tool response

logger.doc:name: Flow end
logger.doc:description: Logs END tracePoint for the get-order-status tool
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Tool get-order-status completed', tracePoint: 'END'} ++ ({ orderId: vars.orderId })]

logger.doc:name: Log tool error
logger.doc:description: Logs EXCEPTION tracePoint with the error type and description before propagating

flow.name: support-tools-create-case-flow
flow.doc:name: Create Support Case Tool
flow.doc:description: MCP tool that opens a Salesforce Case for a TechWave order needing human follow-up

mcp:tool-listener.name: create-support-case
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Tool: create-support-case
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Exposes create-support-case as an MCP tool that creates a Salesforce support Case
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Abre um Case de suporte no Salesforce para um pedido TechWave. Use quando o cliente reportar um problema que exija acompanhamento humano.

logger.doc:name: Flow start
logger.doc:description: Logs START tracePoint with the order id and priority of the new Case
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Tool create-support-case invoked', tracePoint: 'START'} ++ ({ orderId: payload.orderId, priority: payload.priority })]

set-variable.doc:name: Set toolInput
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the full tool input (orderId, subject, description, priority) for downstream use

logger.doc:name: Before Salesforce call
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST as the flow creates the Case in Salesforce

salesforce:create.doc:name: Create Case
salesforce:create.doc:description: Creates a Salesforce Case from the tool input, prefixing the subject with the order id

logger.doc:name: After Salesforce call
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST once Salesforce has created the Case

ee:transform.doc:name: Build tool result
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the JSON tool result with the new caseId, success flag and order id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { caseId: payload.items[0].id, success: payload.items[0].successful, orderId: vars.toolInput.orderId }

logger.doc:name: Flow end
logger.doc:description: Logs END tracePoint with the order id and created caseId
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Tool create-support-case completed', tracePoint: 'END'} ++ ({ orderId: vars.toolInput.orderId, caseId: payload.caseId })]

logger.doc:name: Log tool error
logger.doc:description: Logs EXCEPTION tracePoint with the error type and description before propagating

flow.name: support-tools-refund-payment-flow
flow.doc:name: Refund Payment Tool
flow.doc:description: MCP tool that creates a full Stripe refund (test mode) for an order's PaymentIntent

mcp:tool-listener.name: refund-payment
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Tool: refund-payment
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Exposes refund-payment as an MCP tool that issues a full Stripe refund for a PaymentIntent
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Cria um reembolso total no Stripe para o pagamento de um pedido. Use apenas após confirmar com o cliente que ele deseja o reembolso.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #['Erro ao criar reembolso: ' ++ (error.description default '') ++ ' | Stripe respondeu: ' ++ (write(error.errorMessage.payload, 'application/json') default 'sem corpo')]

logger.doc:name: Flow start
logger.doc:description: Logs START tracePoint with the PaymentIntent id and refund reason
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Tool refund-payment invoked', tracePoint: 'START'} ++ ({ paymentIntentId: payload.paymentIntentId, reason: payload.reason })]

set-variable.doc:name: Set toolInput
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the tool input (paymentIntentId, reason) for the refund request

logger.doc:name: Before Stripe call
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST as the flow creates the Stripe refund

http:request.doc:name: Create Stripe refund
http:request.doc:description: POSTs a full refund to Stripe for the given PaymentIntent and reason

logger.doc:name: After Stripe call
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST once Stripe has created the refund

ee:transform.doc:name: Build tool result
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the JSON tool result with the refund id, status and amount in major units

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { refundId: payload.id, status: payload.status, amount: (payload.amount default 0) / 100, currency: upper(payload.currency default "usd") }

logger.doc:name: Flow end
logger.doc:description: Logs END tracePoint with the refund id and status
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Tool refund-payment completed', tracePoint: 'END'} ++ ({ refundId: payload.refundId, status: payload.status })]

logger.doc:name: Log tool error
logger.doc:description: Logs EXCEPTION tracePoint with the error type and description before propagating

flow.name: support-tools-notify-team-flow
flow.doc:name: Notify Team Tool
flow.doc:description: MCP tool that posts a support notification to the configured Slack channel

mcp:tool-listener.name: notify-team
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Tool: notify-team
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Exposes notify-team as an MCP tool that sends a message to the support Slack channel
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Envia uma notificação para o canal do time de suporte no Slack. Use para avisar o time sobre cases criados ou reembolsos processados.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #['Notificação enviada ao canal de suporte no Slack.']

logger.doc:name: Flow start
logger.doc:description: Logs START tracePoint for the notify-team tool

set-variable.doc:name: Set toolInput
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the tool input (message) for the Slack post

logger.doc:name: Before Slack call
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST as the flow posts the message to Slack

http:request.doc:name: Post to Slack
http:request.doc:description: POSTs the support message to the configured Slack channel via chat.postMessage

logger.doc:name: After Slack call
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST with the Slack ok flag from the response
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'Slack responded', tracePoint: 'AFTER_REQUEST'} ++ ({ ok: payload.ok default false, slackError: payload.error default null })]

choice.doc:name: Slack aceitou a mensagem?
choice.doc:description: Converte o ok=false do corpo da resposta Slack em erro de verdade

raise-error.doc:name: Slack recusou a mensagem
raise-error.description: #['Slack recusou a mensagem: ' ++ (payload.error default 'erro desconhecido') ++ '. Verifique se o bot foi convidado para o canal (/invite @bot) e se o escopo chat:write está presente.']

logger.doc:name: Log tool error
logger.doc:description: Logs EXCEPTION tracePoint with the error type and description before propagating
